title: Error document
description: What a failed `recon` run says about itself when --json was given. Emitted only when the run failed and printed no document of its own, so a --json run always produces exactly one document: either the command's, or this one explaining its exit code.

kind.description: usage = the arguments were wrong (exit 2); configuration = a config file was wrong (exit 3); check_failed = a check ran and failed (exit 1); internal = a bug (exit 4).

message.description: The first thing that went wrong.

errors.description: Every line the run wrote to stderr, in order.

diagnostics.description: Structured diagnostics for a configuration failure: the file, the line and the key to fix.

exit_code.description: The same number the process exits with: 1 check failed, 2 usage, 3 configuration, 4 internal.
